cases.sql: CREATE TABLE indexed_reads(id integer PRIMARY KEY, qty integer, body text, title text); CREATE INDEX indexed_qty ON indexed_reads(qty); INSERT INTO indexed_reads SELECT i,i,CASE WHEN i=5 THEN '' WHEN i=7 THEN NULL WHEN i%2=0 THEN 'alpha beta' ELSE 'alpha gamma' END,CASE WHEN i%3=0 THEN 'beta' ELSE NULL END FROM generate_series(1,32) g(i)
CREATE INDEX indexed_body ON indexed_reads USING gin(body); CREATE INDEX indexed_title ON indexed_reads USING gin(title)
